method: Chromium rendered each sitemap route in same-origin frames at four layout widths, waited for fonts, and inspected text range rectangles against clipping ancestors and the real document client width.
fixes: Removed a 320px body minimum that overflowed the usable viewport beside a scrollbar
Restored intentionally hidden brand sublabels in compact model marks with adequate selector specificity
Changed methodology grid tracks to minmax(0,1fr), with shrinkable cards and wrapping for long words
limitations: DOM rectangle checks are supplemented by visual inspection; they are not pixel-level measurements of every glyph
Frame layout widths are not a substitute for separate real mobile emulation
No live publication or search ranking claim
